scope: one natural-language query/context, four actual Ask OKF tool invocations; not a model comparison
question: Where a child is awarded the highest-rate care component of DLA from 26 January 2025, but the change is reported to Universal Credit on 28 March 2026, what's the effective date of the higher disabled-child addition, and from which assessment period should it be paid?
observed_findings: All 38 selected catalogue entries were inspected; no entry was from ADM A4.
F1123 source text was read in full, with its official PDF page also inspected independently.
Many selected catalogue entries concern Pension Credit, Severe Disablement Allowance, PIP transfer or overseas absence rather than the effective-date issue.
The visible diagnostics report retrieval query, candidate and resource budgets and an acronym-resolution requirement, not a tailored effective-date requirement.
The controlling A4361 rule was found separately through official web sources, not returned by this selected evidence context.
limitations: Only one selected source passage was read in full; the other selected source texts were not all read.
Diagnostics inspection stopped at the first explicit bounded slice; the rest was not read.
The full package was not reconstructed, so its server-supplied digest was not independently verified here.
No latency, model-token count, billed cost or complete host-wire trace was measured.
The experiment does not establish a root cause, overall retrieval accuracy, answer accuracy or comparative performance.
Explicit tool pagination was observed; independent host-level clipping detection was not instrumented.
No Codex, Claude, Gemini, M365 Copilot or browser page-tool run was performed here.
